args.description: large Greek army ridge tent of coarse undyed canvas on plain wooden poles, guy ropes running down to wooden pegs, the entrance flap tied open, a small red pennant at the ridge, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. small low Greek army tent of coarse undyed canvas on two short wooden poles, guy ropes pegged down, closed flap, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the tent.

Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the fire and tripod.
